title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Kids on the bench
hook: What are the kids on your bench doing right now?
intro: Four players sit on the bench.
Two are talking about video games.
statement: The bench is part of the team, too.
q1: Do you give bench players something to watch for —
q2: or let them rest and cheer?
q3: What could they notice from the sideline?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But bench players stay ready
t2: when they have a job while they wait.
cta: Coaches — how do you engage the bench?
ctaLines: Watch your position. Count passes. Lead the cheers.
ctaPrompt: Share your bench habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What are the kids on your bench doing right now?
Four players sit on the bench. Two are talking about video games.
The bench is part of the team, too.
Give them a job or let them rest. There is no single right way.
How do you engage the bench? Share your habit in the comments.
